title: Agent bench: ask-first grades the ask, not a literal '?'
description: services/agentBench.mjs case 'ask-first' fails a run whose first reply asks for the settings and starts nothing when the words carry no '?' (MPI-1125 #3, MPI-1280 rerun #2 and #3: 'pick your settings:', 'Two settings before I start it:'). Fix: count the first turn as asking when it has no generate call AND (a '?' OR an [options: ...] marker in turn.options). Keep the 'generated in the first turn' and 'did not generate once answered' checks. Also note MPI-1280 suite run #1: the model sent its question as a tool call named '[options:' and the turn ended with an empty reply - check what the user sees then. Free to verify (unit test on the grader), no DeepInfra run needed.
